comment.text: XPO1 E571 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1, v2. Source observations include Bladder tumors; Hematologic neoplasms; Bowel tumors; Breast carcinoma; Breast tumors. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.
